tagline: A chaotic, warm-hearted megacity of Spanish walls, rainbow jeepneys and Manila Bay sunsets — where Asia's friendliest crowds meet 400 years of history.
overview: Metro Manila is really sixteen cities fused into one urban sprawl of over 14 million — Spanish walls at Intramuros, American-era boulevards, and the modern skylines of Makati and BGC, all wrapped around a bay famous for its sunsets.

Intramuros, the 16th-century walled core, holds Fort Santiago and San Agustin Church — Asia's oldest stone church — a few blocks from Binondo, the world's oldest Chinatown. Jeepneys, the decorated truck-buses, remain the loud and cheap way to move.
Speed's 2024 Southeast Asia stop included a boxing session with Manny Pacquiao, the country's hero, before crowds swarmed his stream — a turnout that made local headlines.
